tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the extracted-data table, the PDF page frame.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells behind the PDF viewer, table header rows, code and raw OCR text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between table rows and panels. Decorative only, never the sole marker of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; meets 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, units (tis. Kč), page and line references, on all three surfaces.

tokens.name: fides
tokens.usage: Brand pine. Primary buttons, the logo field, active navigation, links on all surfaces.

tokens.name: on-fides
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a fides fill.

tokens.name: fides-tint
tokens.usage: Selected table row, hovered source highlight; fides text reads on it.

tokens.name: seal
tokens.usage: Brass accent: the seal square in the logo and the source-trace marker that links a figure to its place in the PDF. Text-safe on all surfaces. Use sparingly, one per view.

tokens.name: seal-tint
tokens.usage: Highlight box drawn over the PDF region a figure came from; ink and seal read on it.

tokens.name: status-verified
tokens.usage: Figure passed the accounting checks. Always paired with the check icon and the word Verified.

tokens.name: status-review
tokens.usage: Low OCR confidence or a re-read is pending. Always paired with the eye icon and the word Review.

tokens.name: status-mismatch
tokens.usage: An accounting check failed (e.g. total assets ≠ total liabilities). Always paired with the cross icon and the word Mismatch.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; ≥8:1 on all surfaces.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Every number, traced to its page.
styles.usage: Presentation titles and the app's empty-state headline. One per screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Company name at the top of a report.

styles.name: verdict
styles.sample: Low bankruptcy risk; liquidity is tight but stable.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Upload the annual report PDF. Fides finds the statements, reads every line and checks that the totals add up.
styles.usage: Running text and table cells with words.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Every amount in tables. Tabular numbers, right-aligned, thin space as thousands separator.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: The headline value in a ratio tile.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, line codes, column headers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside compact controls; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; gap between a figure and its source chip.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of page to first heading; presentation slide margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, source chips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, the PDF page frame.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The logo field (48px mark) and modal dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-page
tokens.usage: Only on the rendered PDF page, so it reads as paper. Cards use line borders, not shadows.
